legitimateExplanations.title: An unattributable delivery signature.
legitimateExplanations.actually: Genuine receipt by agency staff, a temporary worker, or a third-party site operator whom the consignee does not have on record.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Ask the consignee who was actually on site in that window rather than only whether the name is on the authorised list.

legitimateExplanations.title: Handwritten annotations added to a consignment note.
legitimateExplanations.actually: Legitimate reservations recorded at handover, which is exactly what the document is designed for.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Establish when the annotation was made and by whom. Contemporaneous reservations are the correct use of the document; retrospective additions are not.

legitimateExplanations.title: The same reference appearing twice.
legitimateExplanations.actually: A split delivery, a re-delivery after a failed attempt, or a documented partial movement.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Check whether the duplication is explained by a recorded split or re-delivery event before treating it as reuse.

legitimateExplanations.title: A milestone or delivery stamp has no matching independent gate record.
legitimateExplanations.actually: An asynchronous feed, a documented manual exception, a site-system outage or a legitimate handover outside the normal system path.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Check the outage and exception logs, obtain the original CMR or consignee confirmation and record the reconciliation result before calling the stamp false.

countermeasures.text: Deduplicate delivery documents automatically by image hash and reference across movements and claims.
Secure the original document before any dispute is progressed, since the evidential value of a copy is limited.
